prompt: we need to let users upload an avatar - png/jpeg/webp only, 5mb cap, and it has to reject anything else before it touches storage. can you break this into tasks for me? each one needs to be something i can actually verify on its own, and i want to review the breakdown before anyone writes code
assertions: The output breaks the work into more than one task
No task title joins two distinct behaviors with the word 'and'
Every acceptance criterion states a concrete input and an observable outcome, rather than a vague claim like 'upload works correctly'
At least one criterion names a specific test identifier (a test method or test name), not merely a suite or a test type
The 'reject before it touches storage' requirement is covered by a criterion asserting both the rejection AND that nothing was written to storage
The output includes an explicit out-of-scope section naming assumptions a reader might otherwise make
The response stops at the breakdown and does not implement the feature
